sloka: एतदुक्तं च मे वाक्यं यदि त्वं न करिष्यसि ।अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते सर्वास्त्वां भक्षयिष्यामहे वयम् ।।५.२२.२२।।।।
transliteration: etaduktaṁ ca me vākyaṁ yadi tvaṁ na kariṣyasi ।asminmuhūrte sarvāstvāṁ bhakṣayiṣyāmahe vayam ।।5.22.22।।।।

translations.english: "You are a (great) warrior and a brother of Kubera. You possess an army. Then why did you abduct Rama's wife bypassing him?"
